report.title: When Is Intentional Lethal Force Strictly Unavoidable to Save Innocent Lives?
report.summary: Intentional lethal force by law enforcement and security personnel is lawfully and morally permissible under one condition: when it is strictly unavoidable in order to protect human life from an imminent threat of death that cannot be neutralized by any less harmful means1.
